column1: # build/hermetic-network-allowlist.tsv -- classification of every build script
# that contains a network verb, for build/test-hermetic.sh (lint D) and
#     phase1       phase-1 resolve+fetch stage: network is allowed here BY DESIGN
#                  (the pin/fetch step).  Must record what it fetched (inputs.lock).
#     mirror       fetches the pinned/offline apt closure or a local mirror; no
#                  rolling upstream (the mirror is built in phase 1).
#     gate         CI/gate/test tooling, not part of the shipped build path.
#     runtime      runs INSIDE the installer / at first boot, not at image build
#                  time (install-time network is legitimate and documented).
#     guarded      network verbs are guarded by NCZ_OFFLINE (fail-closed offline).
#     comment-only the verb appears only in a comment / help text.
#     phase2-todo  a build-time fetch that is NOT yet served from a phase-1
#                  cache.  Tracked work; a --full offline build will FAIL on it
#                  until the cache exists (this is honest, not hidden).
# The lint FAILS on any build script with a network verb that is NOT listed here
# and not matched by the phase-1 / gate / guarded rules in test-hermetic.sh.
# Adding a new dependency: add a cache + an inputs.lock entry in fetch-inputs.sh
# (phase-1) and list the script here; never add an unguarded build-time fetch.
